info.name: Deno Deploy API v2 Apps API
info.description:
The Deno Deploy REST API v2 enables programmatic management of applications, revisions, layers, and configuration on the Deno Deploy serverless edge platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: Deno Deploy Support

request.description: Retrieves complete details for a specific application identified by its UUID or human-readable slug, including its labels, attached layers, environment variables, and configuration.

request.description: Updates one or more mutable properties of an existing application. The slug, labels, layers, environment variables, and configuration can each be modified independently. Label updates replace all existing labels. Layer updates replace all layer references. Environment variable updates use deep merge semantics.
